uncertainties.note: Bickering exchange between two unnamed speakers (high-school rivalry, lent CDV, wrecked bike). No color-tagged names anywhere in this span; tonally distinct (civilian slang, 'head office') from the surrounding military mission dialogue. Could be an out-of-order/unused omake exchange per the corpus's stored-table-order note. Left neutral; no speaker identity or gender assigned.

'Guns CDV' (ガンズのＣＤＶ) kept as a literal untranslated proper noun. Possibly a real-world band/media reference; not researched further given its minor comedic weight. Flagged as a glossary proposal for confirmation if it recurs.

'ミラード大佐' (Colonel Millard): WebSearch across Gundam Wing/UC, Macross Plus, and ACE3 fan-wiki sources found no matching named character. Katakana ミラード directly matches the common English name 'Millard', which is used as the best-available literal rendering. Likely an ACE3-original/invented minor NPC. New Edwards Base itself is confirmed (Gundam Wing, gundam.fandom.com/wiki/Field_Marshal_Noventa).

'ホシノ艦長' translated literally as 'Captain Hoshino' (ship-captain title, per terms_028.json's kanchou=Captain rule). The existing corpus (batch_01073 row 1104, encyclopedia_022.json) locks her as 'Lieutenant Commander Ruri Hoshino'. Both may be correct in different senses (rank vs. shipboard title) but read inconsistently side by side; left for orchestrator/central rank normalization rather than silently changed here.
